subject: how to write a data frame to remote server using rhbase?

messages.author: 5c016c0a556e92b6
messages.subject: how to write a data frame to remote server using rhbase?
parts:
I have a R script in which I have a data frame and I want to write this data frame to the remote server. I found this command which write a data frame to a file:

write.table (data_frame, file=pipe ("hadoop dfs -put - /path/to/file.txt"), sep="\t")

But the problem with this command is that it writes to the local system instead of remote server. How can I modify the command or add some more syntax so that it writes to remote server. My major objective is to be able to write the data frame (without col name and row name) in R script to a file on remote server. If there is some better way then please suggest me.

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: how to write a data frame to remote server using rhbase?
parts: write.table is part of the package utils, which is not part of the topics covered here. If you want to use rhbase, the first step is to load rhbase, read the manual, and try one of the functions in the package. I suspect that you are also learning R at the same time ("finding write.table" is an early step for most R users). Trying to learn R and RHadoop at the same time may not be a good idea. Actually, I don't know anyone who's pulled it off. One day, parallel distributed programming may be entry level and we won't program anything else anymore. Today, we are not there.
